en: Sepia-toned image showing a large castle complex with a tall round tower rising above surrounding trees and buildings. In the foreground there is a dirt road with a simple wooden fence and utility poles, bordered by meadows and dense woodland. The printed caption in German at the top left reads "Schloss Gnandstein b. Kohren." The overall style looks like an early 20th‑century photographic postcard.
